description: This file defines the 'Antispam' model class for the OpenCart admin CMS module. It provides methods to add, edit, delete, retrieve, and list antispam keywords stored in the database, along with methods to get total counts. It interacts with database tables and is meant for backend management of spam keywords.

classes.name: Antispam
classes.description: Model class for managing antispam keywords in the database, providing CRUD operations and listing/filtering capabilities.

methods.name: addAntispam
methods.description: Creates a new antispam record in the database with the provided keyword.

methods.name: editAntispam
methods.description: Updates an existing antispam record identified by its ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteAntispam
methods.description: Deletes an antispam record from the database by its ID.

methods.name: getAntispam
methods.description: Retrieves a specific antispam record by its ID.

methods.name: getAntispams
methods.description: Retrieves a list of antispam records, possibly filtered, sorted, and paginated.

methods.name: getTotalAntispams
methods.description: Returns the total number of antispam records, optionally filtered.
